metadata.datasource: Film Lab draft. FUJIFILM Eterna Vivid 160 motion picture film datasheet (fuji_sheets/eterna_vivid160.pdf). Read from the PDF vector graphs: spectral sensitivity, characteristic curves (status M), midscale neutral (dye curves are spektrafilm kodak_vision3_250d dyes fitted to it), minimum density. Sensitivity tails beyond the plotted range, DIR coupler settings and the layout are borrowed from spektrafilm kodak_vision3_250d. Original data are property of the respective holders.
